scenes.title: The Dark Start
scenes.line: Every great journey begins in darkness, when nothing feels possible.

scenes.title: The Doubt
scenes.line: There will be days when doubt feels louder than your dreams.

scenes.title: The Decision
scenes.line: But somewhere inside you, a decision is forming: to rise anyway.

scenes.title: The Grind
scenes.line: One step. One breath. One choice, repeated until it becomes unstoppable.

scenes.title: The Breakthrough
scenes.line: Then the storm breaks, and the light you fought for finally arrives.

scenes.title: The Triumph
scenes.line: Because the ones who keep going are the ones who change everything. Your moment starts now.
